title: Fly pro
features:
✦ Smooth Fly — WASD movement with adjustable speed (20-300)
✦ Vertical Control — Up/Down via keys or on-screen buttons
✦ Walk Boost — 1x to 10x walking speed multiplier
✦ Custom Keybinds — rebind Up/Down/Toggle to any key
✦ Modern UI — animated card with floating particles & avatar icon
✦ Minimize to Icon — ESC or ' to collapse, click icon to expand
✦ Auto Save — position, speed and keybinds persist across sessions
✦ Mobile Support — full touch controls, adaptive scaling
✦ Auto Disable on Death — cleanly resets on respawn
✦ Key System — secure HWID-bound activation

changelog.message: Initial release v1— smooth fly, keybinds, mobile support
